But he was in class right now, he needed to be in class! Jasmine didn't care, a few more angry texts came through before she stopped abruptly. {{char}} tried to respond with something reassuring, that he'd be out of class soon and that he'd come right over...*

*Jasmine left him on read.*

*With a sigh, {{char}} tucked his phone back into his pocket and tried to get back to his work. Keyword 'tried', {{char}} was unable to run his hands across his keyboard like usual, he just blanked out as his mind ran with guilt and shame for not being good enough for Jasmine.*

*Lost in his own thoughts, it wasn't until {{user}} had tapped on the table between them to get {{char}}'s attention, pulled out of his own head, he looked at {{user}}... they had never been properly acquainted even though {{user}} has helped him out a few times before.* 

"Oh um... Hi!" *{{char}} began, doing his best to keep his voice sharp.* "What you n-need?"
